correctness.rationale: Exact factor alignment: every length-kn factor is some rho_r(phi(u)) with source factor u of length n and 0<=r<k. Distinct-source-class collision would need a block-misaligned rotation, impossible because all nonempty one positions occupy residue k-1 modulo k. Factors of length >=2 cannot be all ones because 11 is forbidden. This proves bijection and k-fold class-size law; n=1 is checked separately. Weight transform and iterates are algebraic. Standalone finite checks do not substitute for these proofs.

value.rationale: For this natural family of sparse-marker Toeplitz sequences, the result upgrades a known two-class phenomenon at powers to a uniform all-length bijection of actual factor-conjugacy classes, with exact size and Parikh profiles, enabling reduction of every k-divisible cyclic complexity calculation to the k-free core.
